title: What is the AI actually doing?
description: Understand drift, hallucination, deception, hidden agendas and consciousness, then use AI to define the work and help build a usable business operating system.
intro: Familiar AI claims deserve a closer look. Learn what the behavior means, why it happens and how to catch or limit it. Then put models to work helping define and build an operation people can use.
positioning: Public education drawn from founder writing and checked against primary research. General operational guidance; proprietary mechanisms excluded.
